definitions: A thin piece of metal with a sharp point at one end and a round head at the other, used for fastening pieces of cloth, paper, etc.
A small, thin piece of metal or wood used for fastening things together or as a support.
A cylindrical part, usually metal, that is used to join or secure parts of a mechanism.
A decorative badge or brooch fastened to clothing with a pin.
One of the ten wooden objects at which a bowler aims in skittles or tenpin bowling.
examples: She fastened the fabric with a pin.
The hinge was secured with a pin.
He wore a pin on his lapel.
